scope: Poaceae installed learner: Phalaris caroliniana and its conflicting infraspecific historical synonym mapping; taxonomy evidence only
duplicate_guardrail: One installed Phalaris caroliniana card. Phalaris angusta Nees ex Trin. is a separately accepted species under POWO. Do not create duplicate cards for the historical names; preserve exact authorship and rank.
discovery: Additional conflict not addressed in the October 23 evidence: Kew's var. angustata mapping differs from ITIS and two peer-reviewed taxonomic treatments; Kew's synonym-page citation contains an internally cautionary 'cited as Phalaris angusta' note.

decisions.name: Phalaris caroliniana Walter
decisions.finding: Kew POWO/WCVP accepts this species in Poaceae, genus Phalaris, originally published in Fl. Carol.:74 (1788). Existing canonical learner accepted-name spelling is correct.

decisions.name: Phalaris angusta Nees ex Trin.
decisions.finding: Kew POWO/WCVP accepts a separate species (1827), not an alias of Phalaris caroliniana. Its authorship and basionym concept are independently indexed by IPNI.

decisions.name: Phalaris intermedia var. angusta (Nees ex Trin.) Chapm.
decisions.finding: Kew maps this rank/name to accepted Phalaris angusta, a homotypic synonym; do not confuse the epithet angusta with Beal's angustata.

decisions.name: Phalaris intermedia var. angustata Beal
decisions.finding: Kew's current accepted-name mapping places Beal's 1896 variety under Phalaris caroliniana, not P. angusta. This is the current POWO-mapping fact, not a universal resolution of the conflicting treatments.

decisions.name: Phalaris intermedia var. angustata Beal typification in Finot 2014
decisions.finding: Finot (2014) places this name under Phalaris angusta and identifies a Pringle 15086 lectotype, MO-1837515, with F-210177 and PH-1087785 isolectotypes. These are published typification references, not independently examined specimen images.

decisions.name: Authorless Phalaris angusta / conflated angusta and angustata
decisions.finding: A single automatic accepted-name mapping for authorless 'Phalaris angusta' or a spelling-normalized merge of 'angusta' and 'angustata' would incorrectly combine different nomenclatural concepts; prohibit that automated rule.

decisions.name: Historical Beal-variety vouchers
decisions.finding: Do not reassign specimens originally labelled Phalaris intermedia var. angustata Beal to either modern species without verifying the historical specimen/type concept and source treatment.

decisions.name: Existing Phalaris caroliniana photo or specimen identity
decisions.finding: Accepted-name taxonomy cannot verify an individual photograph or collection; retain all pre-existing source-photo/specimen ID holds and avoid relabelling.

decisions.name: Phalaris intermedia var. angustata Beal accepted-name conflict
decisions.finding: Kew POWO/WCVP maps the name to P. caroliniana; ITIS TSN 41340 lists it under P. angusta; Finot 2014 and Voshell et al. 2016 place it under P. angusta. This is a real authority disagreement. Kew's synonym page also cites a World Grass Species authority as 'Phalaris angusta' while displaying P. caroliniana as accepted. Preserve both mappings with authority and date; no universal alias reassignment.

decisions.name: Independent lectotype comparison
decisions.finding: The published lectotype/isotype identifiers are available from Finot 2014, but actual type images and Beal's 1896 protologue were not independently examined in this run. No nomenclatural override or specimen-level decision is justified.

recommendation: Keep current Kew-accepted Phalaris caroliniana canonical identity unchanged. Preserve POWO synonym mapping as POWO-specific PASS; record cross-authority disagreement as UNRESOLVED. Require human type/protologue review before reassigning historical Beal-variety specimens. No installation, photos, lessons, native-range review or Pages changes.
